<style>
body{background:#FFFFFF}.navbar{background:#FFFFFF!important}
.ct{--ink:#141D44;--tx:#192450;--mu:#5B6172;--ln:#E0E3EB;--soft:#F3F5FA;--tint:#EEF2FD;--or:#1E2A5A;color:var(--tx)}
.ct .wrap{max-width:1180px}

.ct-card{background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:20px;padding:30px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(20,40,74,.05)}
.ct-card .ic{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--tint);color:var(--or);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.ct-card .ic svg{width:24px;height:24px}
.ct-card h2{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);margin:6px 0 0;letter-spacing:-.4px}
.ct-card p{margin:0;font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.75;word-break:keep-all;flex-grow:1}
.ct-acts{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:6px}
.ct-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:44px;padding:0 18px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;text-decoration:none;background:var(--or);color:#FFFFFF}
.ct-btn:hover{background:#1E2A5A;color:#FFFFFF}
.ct-btn.sub{background:#FFFFFF;color:var(--ink);border:1.5px solid var(--ln)}
.ct-btn.sub:hover{border-color:var(--ink);color:var(--ink)}
.ct-btn svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.ct-info{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:20px;padding:20px 0 104px}
.ct-box{background:var(--soft);border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:20px;padding:32px}
.ct-box h2{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 4px}
.ct-box .org{font-size:15px;color:var(--or);margin:0 0 20px}
.ct-line{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--ln)}
.ct-line:first-of-type{border-top:0}
.ct-line .ico{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--or);color:#FFFFFF;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none}
.ct-line .ico svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.ct-line small{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--mu)}
.ct-line a{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
.ct-line a:hover{color:var(--or)}
.ct-box ul{margin:8px 0 0;padding-left:20px;font-size:15.5px;line-height:2}
.ct-form{margin-top:20px;display:none}
.ct-form.on{display:block}
@media (max-width:900px){.ct-hero{padding:56px 0 24px}.ct h1{font-size:32px}.ct-hero p{font-size:16px}.ct-types,.ct-info{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ct-info{padding-bottom:72px}.ct-box,.ct-card{padding:24px}}
